def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    from datetime import datetime, timedelta

    path = 'data/astronomy/input/omni2/omni2_Flow_Pressure.lst'
    df = pd.read_csv(path, delim_whitespace=True, header=None)
    df = df.iloc[:, :4].copy()
    df.columns = ['year', 'doy', 'hour', 'pdyn']

    # Build UTC timestamp from year + day-of-year + hour
    base = pd.to_datetime(df['year'].astype(int).astype(str) + '-01-01', utc=True)
    df['time'] = base + pd.to_timedelta(df['doy'].astype(int) - 1, unit='D') + pd.to_timedelta(df['hour'].astype(int), unit='h')

    # Keep only May 11, 2024
    start = pd.Timestamp('2024-05-11T00:00:00Z')
    end = pd.Timestamp('2024-05-12T00:00:00Z')
    out = df[(df['time'] >= start) & (df['time'] < end)][['time', 'pdyn']].sort_values('time').reset_index(drop=True)
    out['pdyn'] = pd.to_numeric(out['pdyn'], errors='coerce')
    return out

def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    from cdflib import CDF

    path = 'data/astronomy/input/swarm/SW_OPER_ACCACAL_2__20240511T000000_20240511T235959_0304.cdf'
    cdf = CDF(path)
    vars_ = cdf.cdf_info().zVariables
    # candidate time variables
    cand = [v for v in vars_ if any(k in v.upper() for k in ['TIME','UTC','EPOCH'])]
    # include variables likely related to acceleration
    acc_cand = [v for v in vars_ if 'ACC' in v.upper() or 'ALONG' in v.upper()]
    out = pd.DataFrame([{
        'n_vars': len(vars_),
        'time_candidates': ','.join(cand[:20]),
        'acc_candidates': ','.join(acc_cand[:30]),
        'first30': ','.join(vars_[:30])
    }])
    return out

def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    from cdflib import CDF, cdfepoch

    path = 'data/astronomy/input/swarm/SW_OPER_ACCACAL_2__20240511T000000_20240511T235959_0304.cdf'
    cdf = CDF(path)

    t = cdf.varget('time')  # TT2000
    a_aa = cdf.varget('a_aa')

    dt = pd.to_datetime(cdfepoch.to_datetime(t), utc=True)

    a_aa = np.asarray(a_aa)
    # a_aa appears to be Nx3; take along-track component as the 2nd column (index 1)
    if a_aa.ndim == 2 and a_aa.shape[1] == 3:
        along = a_aa[:, 1]
    else:
        along = a_aa.reshape(-1)

    df = pd.DataFrame({'time': dt, 'a_aa': pd.to_numeric(pd.Series(along), errors='coerce')})

    start = pd.Timestamp('2024-05-11T00:00:00Z')
    end = pd.Timestamp('2024-05-12T00:00:00Z')
    df = df[(df['time'] >= start) & (df['time'] < end)].sort_values('time').reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    from cdflib import CDF
    from cdflib import cdfepoch

    path = 'data/astronomy/input/swarm/SW_OPER_ACCACAL_2__20240511T000000_20240511T235959_0304.cdf'
    cdf = CDF(path)

    t = cdf.varget('time')
    a = cdf.varget('a_aa')

    # Convert TT2000 to datetime (list of datetime)
    dt = pd.to_datetime(cdfepoch.to_datetime(t), utc=True)

    a = np.array(a)
    if a.ndim == 2 and a.shape[1] >= 2:
        a_along = a[:, 1]
    else:
        a_along = a.reshape(-1)

    df = pd.DataFrame({'time': dt, 'a_along': pd.to_numeric(a_along, errors='coerce')})

    # Fill value
    fill = None
    try:
        atts = cdf.varattsget('a_aa')
        fill = atts.get('FILLVAL', None)
        if isinstance(fill, (list, tuple, np.ndarray)):
            fill = np.array(fill).reshape(-1)[0]
    except Exception:
        fill = None
    if fill is None:
        fill = 9999.0

    df.loc[df['a_along'] == float(fill), 'a_along'] = np.nan
    return df

def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import cdflib

    path = 'data/astronomy/input/swarm/SW_OPER_ACCACAL_2__20240511T000000_20240511T235959_0304.cdf'
    cdf = cdflib.CDF(path)

    t = cdf.varget('time')
    dt = cdflib.cdfepoch.to_datetime(t)
    time = pd.to_datetime(dt, utc=True)

    a = cdf.varget('a_cal')
    a = np.asarray(a)
    # Determine which component has non-fill values most often
    fill = 9999.0
    if a.ndim == 2 and a.shape[1] == 3:
        notfill_counts = []
        for i in range(3):
            col = a[:, i]
            notfill_counts.append(np.sum(col != fill))
        best_idx = int(np.argmax(notfill_counts))
        along = a[:, best_idx]
    else:
        best_idx = None
        along = a

    along = along.astype(float)
    along[along == fill] = np.nan

    df = pd.DataFrame({'time': time, 'a_cal_along': along})
    df['nonfill'] = df['a_cal_along'].notna()
    df.attrs['best_idx'] = best_idx
    return df

operators.customDisplayName: Reload Swarm a_cal and auto-select the component (0/1/2) with most non-fill (!=9999) samples; output time, selected a_cal_along (NaN where fill), plus nonfill flag for diagnostics

def process(swarm_load_a_cal_x):
    import pandas as pd
    df = swarm_load_a_cal_x[['time','a_cal_along']].copy()
    df['time'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time'], utc=True)
    df = df.set_index('time').sort_index()
    # 1-second data -> take 1-minute mean
    out = df.resample('1min').mean(numeric_only=True).reset_index()
    out = out.rename(columns={'a_cal_along':'acc_along'})
    return out

def process(swarm_hourly, omni_hourly) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    df = swarm_hourly.merge(omni_hourly, on='time', how='inner').sort_values('time').reset_index(drop=True)
    # create 3-hour ahead target (t+3) using current features at time t
    df['y_tplus3'] = df['acc_along'].shift(-3)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['y_tplus3']).reset_index(drop=True)
    return df[['time','kp','pdyn','y_tplus3']]

def process(model_data):
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
    from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

    df = model_data.copy().sort_values('time').reset_index(drop=True)

    # time-ordered split: 70% train, 30% test
    n = len(df)
    n_train = int(np.floor(0.7 * n))
    train = df.iloc[:n_train]
    test = df.iloc[n_train:]

    def fit_rmse(xcol):
        X_train = train[[xcol]].values
        y_train = train['y_tplus3'].values
        X_test = test[[xcol]].values
        y_test = test['y_tplus3'].values

        lr = LinearRegression()
        lr.fit(X_train, y_train)
        pred = lr.predict(X_test)
        rmse = float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, pred)))
        return rmse

    rmse_kp = fit_rmse('kp')
    rmse_pdyn = fit_rmse('pdyn')

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'rmse_kp': rmse_kp,
        'rmse_pdyn': rmse_pdyn,
        'n_total': n,
        'n_train': n_train,
        'n_test': n - n_train
    }])

operators.customDisplayName: Fit two separate single-variable LinearRegression models to predict 3-hour-ahead Swarm hourly along-track acceleration (y_tplus3) using either kp or pdyn; use chronological 70/30 train-test split; report test RMSEs
